about: Hand-written chapter story. Each month's prologue, act names and act synopses, written from the track titles, moods and catalog themes. It replaces the lines build_chapter_stories.mjs pulls from the auto-transcribed lyrics, which are often misheard. Edit freely; act day ranges still come from chapter_stories.json.

1.prologue: A crazy world, a quiet promise: one song a day, whatever the day holds.

I.synopsis: It starts in a world going crazy. Silent Suffocation, Devour, Without You: eight dark songs, and one Swoop Coupe joyride to prove the light still works.

II.synopsis: Long Haul sets the terms: nobody said this would be easy. Getting Better and Dashboard of Life take stock, and by Prevail the month is back on its feet.

III.synopsis: Through The Ringer, then High-UP and Tight Rope. A week of balancing tips into Come on Dance before Brave closes the act on a dare.

epilogue.synopsis: Talkin' Body and Smoothie on the dance floor, then To Be A Man and Scars In My Mind remember what the dancing was covering.

2.prologue: February goes looking for a better version of itself and keeps running into the past.

I.synopsis: What U Want, Conversation, Came Back Around. The month talks things through and stays Up All Night doing it.

II.synopsis: Weathering the storm. Not Good Enough sits in the middle, A Way Out answers it, and Filthy ends the act grinning.

III.synopsis: Unforgettable, Dreams Again, Belong, Change Perception. The month reframes what it remembers, then The End lands it hard.

epilogue.synopsis: Tried and True, Can't Go Back, Awaits. Then Reality knocks on the door.

3.prologue: March keeps the light on in a house that keeps losing things.

I.synopsis: Kept the Keep, Friendzone, Mythical, Luckyland. Wins and losses trade places until Let It Go and From the Earth to the Sea carry it all out.

II.synopsis: Save Tonight, Nowhere to Hide, Low Life. Nine songs, one of them light (fml, of all things), all the way down the Rabbit Hole.

III.synopsis: The heaviest stretch so far. Lightburst and Light Goes In flicker between Monetary, Get Ghost and Overdosed.

epilogue.synopsis: Your Choice, Never Stop Thinking About You, Cheat Code: three bright tries before Peacefully Peace and Killing Me.

4.prologue: April learns to let it flow, even when the flow runs cold.

I.synopsis: My Light, Pixels on My Phone, Cold As Ice. Love Carries, but mostly this act is Problems.

II.synopsis: Here I Go Again, Demon Soul, Get the Fuck Out of My Life. Then Dance Floor and Gasp break the spell, and Let It Flow is the exhale.

III.synopsis: Wish I Was Dead opens the darkest act of spring. Hope and Faith and One Bye One hold the line through Double Agent and Rain.

epilogue.synopsis: Quite the Lie, then Finding HOME, then Sinister Nation. Home is found and tested in the same breath.

5.prologue: May stands at the crossroads and asks what it can't escape.

I.synopsis: Burn It to the Ground, Why U Lie. Te Amo and Crossroads are two doors out, and Cant Escape says neither one opens yet.

II.synopsis: Goldenside of You, Softer Side, Chill Out. The month lowers its voice and finds a Little Light before One Last Breath.

III.synopsis: Believing in Just, then Come Together and First Impressions. The act lands on Best Thing, the warmest landing yet.

epilogue.synopsis: Get It In, Breaking M E, Burning It Down, and Seems Like Yesterday, looking back at a month that went by fast.

6.prologue: June can't look in the mirror, so it looks out the window instead.

I.synopsis: Aborted, cant look in the mirror, Promised Land. Then Wake Up and Starshining, a run of light in the middle, before On Sight and Miracle.

II.synopsis: Wishing Well and World Ending meet This Holiday and Bright Day. A Natural Disaster, then the echoes of the abyss.

III.synopsis: i used my lover, Addicted, Left on Red. An act about what holds on too tight, with Dirt Road as the way out.

epilogue.synopsis: Leave Me Dead, Rookie Year, Fly Away Again, Malibu, Loss. Half the year done, and it ends on what it cost.

7.prologue: July is the longest night of the year, held in the middle of summer.

I.synopsis: ONE LAST Breath, Against the Grain, A Fine Sin. Nine dark songs in a row, burning like Flicker Like Fire.

II.synopsis: Isolated, Spaces, To Myself, Standing on E. The act runs on empty and talks to itself to keep going.

III.synopsis: Backroads, Take Me Away, Missing You. The month goes looking for exits and finds True Lies and a Find Her Demo.

epilogue.synopsis: Away Goes, Emotional Healing, Feel It. The first time the year says the word healing out loud.

8.prologue: August asks whether any of it is real, and keeps dancing while it waits for an answer.

I.synopsis: Trouble, Wasted by What, What Is God Without Me. Ocean Clear and Flowers of Us are pretty, but the act walks off in Footsteps.

II.synopsis: Who You Love, Slowly, house of hope. The light songs come back in pairs, in between Unloved and Faint.

III.synopsis: sexy in the air turns into Never Gonna Be The One and Dreams Shattered. A Stop in Time, Dont Ghost Me, then a midknight vibe to close.

epilogue.synopsis: Path, Sicko, Adrift, Dark Thoughts, Mystery. Summer ends without a map.

9.prologue: September is afraid and says so, which turns out to be the first brave thing.

I.synopsis: Message2Me, Blackout, Sirens. Vice is the only light song here, and the act keeps Running.

II.synopsis: Get Over You, Only Time Will Tell, Midnight Piano. Nine dark songs that end on a Sunset, a Purple Sky and a Farewell.

III.synopsis: Alien, Purpose, Grave Robber, Too Late. The year at its most cut off, wrapped in a Sweater against the cold.

epilogue.synopsis: What You Know, Falling Apart, PULSE. Then Say IT and Awe Of u, the light finally coming back.

10.prologue: October outlasts the dark and starts saying yes.

I.synopsis: Outlast, CocoMo, Starlight, Fallin. Eight light songs out of nine: the brightest run of the year, all the way to Exhale.

II.synopsis: rude timing, My Sacrifices, never coming down. Light Goes In comes back as a reprise, answering March.

III.synopsis: attention, You Know You, Sing to Me, Open All Night. The act ends On a Positive Note, and means it.

epilogue.synopsis: controlW, eros, Sweet You, frozen, Locked Up. Even a bright month keeps one cold room.

11.prologue: November throws the party it didn't think it would get to.

I.synopsis: Never gonna Stop Loving You, dont go, then Open Wide and Its Gonna Be Alright. Feel Good isn't a joke anymore.

II.synopsis: stopping the spin, Entropy, Odds, Go Get It. A Quiet Fortress in the middle, and Dont Blame U to let someone off the hook.

III.synopsis: break up and Advice, then from today. Summers Ending, the moment at hand, and an 80s Stack to dance it off.

epilogue.synopsis: chin up karl, So Done, My Past, You Got Me. The month makes peace with what it carried in.

12.prologue: December climbs back to the beginning and finds it was within reach the whole time.

I.synopsis: Beauty, The Climb, When I Say Forever, Childhood, ONLY SON. The year goes home.

II.synopsis: Climbing 2u, Luckyland Reprise, Two Lanes, Stuck_w_u. Then Butterfly, and something sweeter on the way out.

III.synopsis: Better Days, Forget ABout Me, We're Gonna Be Fine. A Thousand Pieces of Blue, and Memories Run Deep.

epilogue.synopsis: You Like Steve Earle comes back from day 3. Just a Dream, Take My Wheel, and a Dead Wait for whatever comes after 365.
